proof_scope: Reviewer trust boundaries for Tau project DAGs

claims.proves: Tau rejects a reviewer_verdict missing tau.reviewer_verdict.v1 schema, rejects reviewer verdicts without reviewer_node_id, blocks reviewer FAIL verdicts, rejects reviewer nodes without reviewer.reviews_node, rejects reviewed-node paths that bypass the reviewer, treats required_evidence as exact evidence kinds instead of JSON substrings, blocks required reviewer branches entering direct or transitive any_success joins, and allows required reviewer branches through all_success joins.
claims.does_not_prove: Provider semantic quality, human acceptance, every non-reviewer evidence class, React Flow rendering, or GOAL.md completion.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau project DAGs reject malformed reviewer verdict evidence, require reviewer declarations to bind and dominate the reviewed creator node, match required_evidence by exact evidence kind, block reviewer FAIL verdicts, and block required reviewer branches from direct or transitive permissive join bypass.
